translation_notes: RDF.type / OWL_NS.Ontology become rdf:type / owl:Ontology; the single graph.add becomes 'self.graph += g{ {self.identifier} a owl:Ontology }'
the draft's 'owl-ns' prefix (mechanically derived from the OWL_NS variable name) is not usable outside islands (a hyphen is subtraction in Python); declared as owl: instead

the OWL_NS = Namespace(...) binding is dropped, absorbed by @prefix owl:. NOTE: in the full infixowl module OWL_NS is exported and used elsewhere, so a whole-file translation would keep the Namespace object next to the @prefix declaration (@prefix produces no runtime object)
the membership test '(self.identifier, rdf:type, owl:Ontology) not in self.graph' stays a Python tuple test: ldpy has no island form for reading/filtering a graph, only for building terms and graphs
context shim: infixowl_ctx.py re-exports Individual/Ontology from rdflib.extras.infixowl (upstream of the vendored copy); imported identically by both sides
demo harness added identically to both sides: the extracted __init__ is run on a bare Ontology instance (twice, to exercise the guard) and the pair is compared on demo_graph + stdout
